title: Step 5 — Safe garbage collection
body:
# Step 5 — Safe garbage collection

Keep the full system working and implement `blobstore.gc`. Compute reachability
from manifests and incomplete upload parts. `plan()` returns sorted candidates
and a state fingerprint; `apply(plan)` rejects stale plans and quarantines
candidates before deletion. `audit()` and dry-run planning are deterministic
and read-only. Never delete a reachable object.
